business_problem: Zespri had HR work scattered across shared mailboxes and manual handoffs, making it difficult for a 54-person digital team to scale employee support and AI adoption across 50 countries.
solution_summary: Zespri had HR work scattered across shared mailboxes and manual handoffs, making it difficult for a 54-person digital team to scale employee support and AI adoption across 50 countries. Zespri implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, HR Service Delivery, IT Service Management, and Workflow Data Fabric. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; HR Service Delivery manages HR cases and onboarding; IT Service Management standardizes incidents and requests; Workflow Data Fabric connects operational data and automation context. The stack also connected Microsoft Teams and shared mailboxes so the workflows could reuse existing records, documents, and collaboration channels instead of forcing teams back into manual handoffs.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow AI Platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the common workflow and AI platform that unifies service data, automation, and user experiences.

solution_components.name: HR Service Delivery
solution_components.role: Moves HR cases, onboarding, and employee support workflows onto the same platform.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Standardizes incident, request, and fulfillment workflows on the platform.

solution_components.name: Workflow Data Fabric
solution_components.role: Connects operational data across systems and powers automation with shared context.

solution_components.name: AI Control Tower
solution_components.role: Provides centralized AI governance, inventory, and ROI tracking across use cases.

data_flow: Work enters as cases, requests, or automations, and uses context from Microsoft Teams and shared mailboxes before ServiceNow AI Platform, HR Service Delivery, IT Service Management, Workflow Data Fabric, and AI Control Tower routes or fulfills the work. The same record of work is then exposed back to agents and end users through the platform.
business_outcome: Zespri reduced incident triage time by 90%, cut resolution time by 25%, and expects to reduce AI certification effort by 80% while scaling AI governance globally.
metrics: 90% Less time to assign and triage incidents
80% Expected cut in the time required for AI certification
architecture_clues: Workflow Data Fabric is used as the shared context layer across multiple systems and workflows.
AI Control Tower centralizes AI inventory, lifecycle status, and ROI tracking.
